findings.statement: Two pretrained checkpoints are released: a 7B model and a 300M model. Both were first published as AIDO.DNA-7B and AIDO.DNA-300M and are now named GB.DNA-7B and GB.DNA-300M on Hugging Face; the old names still resolve to the new repositories. In ModelGenerator the backbones are gb_dna_7b and gb_dna_300m, and the old names aido_dna_7b and aido_dna_300m remain as deprecated aliases. The 300M card gives no training details of its own and refers to the 7B card. A result should name the checkpoint and its revision; this page read GB.DNA-7B at 5dd948f7 and GB.DNA-300M at a833c560.
findings.source_says: mg-backbones-init.py: "Deprecated backbone aliases (AIDO.* -> GB.* rebrand)" with "aido_dna_7b": "gb_dna_7b". No saved file records this. (that the old Hugging Face names redirect)
